title: A textbook milestone table lists taking turns at age 3
summary: OpenStax Psychology's milestone table lists taking turns among the personal and social items at age 3.
body: Table 9.4 in the lifespan chapter has a personal and social column. At age 3 that cell includes taking turns, along with expressing many emotions. The table is a compact textbook list of average-style ages. It does not say 75 percent, and it is not the CDC line that puts following rules or taking turns in games with other children at 5 years. Both can be true only as different lists. This card is the table's age-3 cell, not a screen.
